title: sre-harness site configuration
description: site.yaml at the root of a site repository. Holds site facts only. Secrets are never stored here: reference them by environment variable name.

repos.description: Repositories the harness reads or writes. The key is a local alias. 'catalog' is the site repository itself.

tracker.description: Where incident tracking issues are opened.

monitoring.description: Monitoring and telemetry sources the agent may query.

tiers_file.description: Path to the service tier definitions, relative to the site root.

audit.description: Where per-incident audit logs are written. The repository must be private.

chat.description: The chat-ops gateway. Empty means no gateway. Holds identities and limits, never a token: secrets_env names the environment variables that hold them.

adapter.description: Chat platform the gateway connects to.

hub_channel.description: Channel ID (not name) where incidents are started and announced.

responders.description: Chat user IDs whose messages reach the agent. Everyone else is ignored.

approvers.description: Chat user IDs whose approval of a tool call counts. Must be a subset of responders. Changed only by reviewed pull request.

approval_ttl_seconds.description: How long an approval request stays answerable.

idle_stop_minutes.description: Idle time after which an incident's agent session is stopped; the next message resumes it.

max_sessions.description: Agent sessions that may run at once.

allow.description: Permission rules this site adds to the plugin's read-only allow-list. The plugin's deny-list still wins.

secrets_env.description: Names of the environment variables holding the chat platform's tokens.

slo.description: Where SLIs are measured and where journeys and SLOs live. Empty means no SLOs. Holds names of credential variables, never credentials.

backend.description: Query API the SLIs are evaluated by: any Prometheus-compatible one, such as Mimir or Grafana Cloud.

url.description: Base URL of the Prometheus API; /api/v1/query is appended. https, or plain http to localhost only: the read token is sent with every query.

user.description: Basic-auth user name, such as a hosted instance ID. Not a secret.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the read token.

token_file.description: Name of a file in ~/.config/sre-harness/ holding the read token, used when token_env is unset. It must be a regular file readable by its owner only.

retention_days.description: How long the backend keeps samples, recorded ones included. No SLO window may be longer.

journeys_path.description: Directory of journey files and their OpenSLO definitions, relative to the site root. No leading /, ~ or .. segments.

rules_file.description: Generated recording rules, relative to the site root. Written by slo.py generate. No leading /, ~ or .. segments.

dashboard_file.description: Generated Grafana dashboard for every SLO, relative to the site root. Written by slo.py dashboard. No leading /, ~ or .. segments.

rules_namespace.description: Ruler namespace the generated rules are synced into.

catalog.description: The service catalog: where entity files live and which sources its generated layer is built from.

path.description: Catalog directory, relative to the site root. Sync writes '<path>/generated/'; people write everywhere else under it.

default_owner.description: Entity ref that owns generated Resources.

runbooks_repo.description: Repository whose runbooks_path the 'runbooks' of a service are resolved against.

patterns_path.description: Directory of deployment pattern pages, relative to the site root. A pattern id is a file name without '.md'.

incident.description: How incidents are worked at this site.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for times shown to people, for example Europe/London. Times are stored in UTC.

severity_criteria.description: Where this site's P1 to P4 criteria are written down.

update_minutes.description: Longest gap between status updates, by severity. A severity left out needs no scheduled updates.

procedures_path.description: Directory of site procedures, relative to the site root.

procedures.description: Which procedure files the agent reads at each stage. File names are relative to procedures_path.

evidence_dir.description: Local directory, outside any repository, for evidence gathered during an incident. '~' is expanded.

drill.description: Where practice incidents are tracked. Must be a private repository so that nothing fake is published.

autonomy_file.description: Allow-list of pre-approved actions, relative to the site root.

assist.description: Optional advisory helper. It suggests; it never approves, blocks or selects an action, never decides a tier, and never sets a final severity. Enabling it sends masked incident text to a third party.

model.description: Model id to pin. Pinning is recommended: an alias can change answers between releases.

mask_file.description: File of site identifiers, one per line, relative to the site root. Each is replaced with a placeholder before anything is sent.

responders.description: Code-host logins whose timeline entries are trusted, beyond the tracker repository's owner, members and collaborators.

reliability.description: Reliability design: where STPA analyses live and the thresholds the recommendations backlog ranks by. Every key is optional; empty means the defaults.

analyses_path.description: Directory in the site repository holding STPA analyses, one <service>.md each. Default analyses/stpa.

theme_min_pirs.description: PIRs on one service or tag, inside the window, that make a recurring theme. Default 3.

theme_window_days.description: Rolling window for recurring themes, in days. Default 180.

stale_action_days.description: An open action item older than this is stale. Default 60.

action_labels.description: Issue labels that mark action items, searched across every owner in repos. Default [incident, design-review].

ignore_tags.description: PIR tags never counted as a theme, such as a tool name on every PIR. Default none.

repoAlias.description: A key of the top-level 'repos' map.

path.description: Local checkout. '~' is expanded. Omit for the catalog repo, which is the site root.

fallback_url.description: Published copy to read when the local checkout is stale or missing.

mcp_server.description: Name of the MCP server that fronts this source, if any.

credentials_env.description: Names of environment variables that hold credentials. Never the values.

name.description: Also the directory name under generated/.

repo.description: Repository alias with a local 'path'. The source is read from that checkout.

path.description: File or directory inside that repository.

pattern.description: Deployment pattern id recorded on every Resource this source generates.

exclude_groups.description: ansible-inventory: skip hosts that belong to any of these groups.

exclude_hosts.description: ansible-inventory, nagios-objects: skip these host names.

cluster.description: argocd-applications: name of the cluster the applications deploy to. Generates one cluster Resource.

kube_context.description: argocd-applications: kubectl context for the optional --check-live report.
